notes: Flat washer, trans mount bracket. OD from Gary Beaupre's kit notes on the original. GM replacement 14037984 is listed as 25/64 ID x 13/16 OD x 1/8 thk (another listing on the same page: 13/32 ID 13/16 OD).

sources.title: 1975 Transmission & Shifter Mount Fastener Kits
sources.quote: item 2b in my kit has an OD of 0.74”, whereas the original GM washer, 6255640, had an OD of 0.81”.
